archetypes.name: state-machine
archetypes.rationale: The diff changes /design step routing, completion sentinels, and the FINALIZE convergence point across several workflow surfaces.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether every fresh /design path now reaches the Step 3b completion boundary before Step 4, including diagram skip, diagram failure, Gate-B bypass, cap-reached, and anti-halt continuation paths. Check that no changed prose or script output creates an alternate direct Step 3b-to-Step 4 route that would skip FINALIZE or step-3b marking. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: resume-legacy
archetypes.rationale: The implementation adds compatibility behavior for paused sessions created before the sentinel relocation.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the legacy pause/resume compatibility paths for sessions with .completed/step-3b but no .completed/finalize, and SIMPLE sessions with .completed/step-2a but no .completed/step-2a.5. Verify that the new guards repair only the missing compatibility markers and do not rerun or overwrite artifacts in ways that change fresh-run behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: bash-fences
archetypes.rationale: The core behavior depends on Markdown-embedded bash fences, fail-fast writes, rc capture, and harness grep/awk assertions.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the modified bash snippets and shell harness logic for quoting, set -e or set +e interactions, rc capture, cleanup, and branch scoping errors. Pay special attention to whether completion markers are written only after prerequisite actions succeed and whether the structural tests can produce false positives or false negatives. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: contract-sync
archetypes.rationale: The change updates multiple normative docs and operator-facing breadcrumbs that must stay synchronized with SKILL.md behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the updated SKILL.md workflow contract with approval-gates.md, flags.md, configuration docs, sketch-launch.md, run-step3-review.sh output, and script reference docs. Look for stale caller descriptions, inconsistent routing language, or documentation that implies a removed standalone turn or separate SIMPLE sentinel write site still exists. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
